salt_pct.quote: * **pH, temperature, salt content ranged from 5.80 to 6.62, 5°C to 12°C, and 0.85% to 1.70%, respectively.**

ammonia.reason: 2-day-old cheese with minimal deamination/urease; no surface flora ammonia release.

animal_barnyard.reason: No p-cresol/indole/skatole from washed-rind or barnyard microbiota.

bitter.reason: Short rennet contact, no accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; 2-heptanone/2-nonanone only trace background.

browning.reason: High moisture and low reducing-sugar/lysine Maillard during brief heating.

buttery.reason: Low diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus starter in pasteurized milk fat without ripening concentration.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Total FFA ~2 mM/kg only; minimal lipase action yields trace butanoic/hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: High moisture plus 21% fat gives smooth, moist mouthfeel without ripened breakdown.

crumbliness.reason: Cohesive rennet curd, not dry-aged; fractures little.

firmness.reason: High moisture 63% rennet gel, dry-salted and molded; soft elastic body.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylethyl alcohol from phenylalanine catabolism, diluted by high moisture.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate detected as presence only; no esterase ripening to accumulate esters.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks caprine branched C8-C10 acids like 4-methyloctanoic acid.

malty_nutty.reason: No ripening proteolysis/Strecker degradation, so 2-/3-methylbutanal near absent.

melt.reason: pH 6.8 retains colloidal calcium phosphate crosslinks, restricting casein flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one lipoxygenase-mold pathway in fresh vacuum-packed curd.

oil_off.reason: Intact fresh protein network entraps fat; little free oil on warming.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make; no guaiacol/syringol from wood smoke deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: pH 6.8 with lactic ~1-2 ug/mL and acetic ~0.5 ug/mL extract; almost no acid development.

stretch.reason: Not pasta-filata; no hot-water kneading or pH 5.2 demineralization for alignment.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low-heat batch pasteurization 65C 30min, uncooked curd; little whey protein H2S/methional.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose and fresh milkfat lactones perceived sweet at high pH/low salt.

umami.reason: Very low free glutamate; rennet proteolysis index minimal at 2 d storage.
